post.description:
Export per-call consumption analytics for the workspace identified by {wId}.
Each row represents one unit of billed credit consumption (an LLM call or a tool call).
The export can be filtered by various dimensions (agents, users, API keys, groups, models, tools, skills, sources, tags).
The export is limited to a maximum of 30 days per request.

parameters.name: wId
parameters.description: Unique string identifier for the workspace

startDate.description: Start of the time range (inclusive), ISO 8601 datetime

endDate.description: End of the time range (exclusive), ISO 8601 datetime. Must be after startDate, at most 30 days apart.

filter.description: Optional dimension filters. Each key maps to an array of string identifiers to include.

api_keys.description: API key names to filter on

tools.description: Tool server names to filter on

tags.description: Agent tag IDs to filter on

200.description: The consumption data in CSV or NDJSON format

schema.description: Newline-delimited JSON, one row object per line

400.description: Invalid request body (missing fields, invalid dates, range exceeds 30 days)

403.description: Requires an API key with admin scope

get.description: Export analytics data for the workspace identified by {wId} in CSV or JSON format.

parameters.name: wId
parameters.description: Unique string identifier for the workspace

parameters.name: table
parameters.description:
The analytics table to export:
- "usage_metrics": Messages, conversations, and active users over time.
- "active_users": Daily, weekly, and monthly active user counts.
- "source": Message volume by context origin (web, slack, etc.).
- "agents": Top agents by message count, including credits.
- "users": Top users by message count, including credits, last login date and membership status (active, revoked, unregistered).
- "skills": Skill metadata catalog.
- "skill_usage": Skill executions and unique users over time.
- "tool_usage": Tool executions and unique users over time.
- "messages": Detailed message-level logs, including comma-separated lists of tools (as "server__tool") and skills used per message, and the cost in credits of each message.
- "feedback": Detailed message-level feedback (thumbs, content, conversation URL).

200.description: The analytics data in CSV or JSON format

400.description: Invalid request query parameters

403.description: Requires an API key with admin scope

get.description: Get the agent configurations for the workspace identified by {wId}.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description:
The view to use when retrieving agents:
- all: Retrieves all non-private agents (default if not authenticated)
- list: Retrieves all active agents accessible to the user (default if authenticated)
- published: Retrieves all agents with published scope
- global: Retrieves all global agents
- favorites: Retrieves all agents marked as favorites by the user (only available to authenticated users)
- all_unrestricted: Retrieves every active agent of the workspace, including unpublished agents the caller does not edit and agents requesting spaces the caller cannot access. Requires an admin key.

parameters.name: withAuthors
parameters.description: When set to 'true', includes recent authors information for each agent

agentConfigurations.description: Array of agent configurations, optionally including lastAuthors if withAuthors=true

400.description: Bad Request. Missing or invalid parameters.

401.description: Unauthorized. Invalid or missing authentication token, or attempting to access restricted views without authentication.

403.description: Forbidden. The all_unrestricted view requires a workspace admin.

patch.description: Update the agent configuration identified by {sId} in the workspace identified by {wId}.

editors.description: Emails of the workspace members to set as editors of the agent. Omitting this field keeps the current editors; providing it replaces the whole list.

skills.description: Replaces the skills enabled on the agent configuration.

toolset.description: Replaces the full set of tools on the agent. Any tool not present in this array is removed, so send the complete desired toolset. Each entry resolves an MCP server by name (see configuration.mcp_server_name). Entries that cannot be resolved are not applied and are returned in the skippedActions field of the response rather than causing the whole request to fail.

mcp_server_name.description: Name of the MCP server to attach. Both built-in (internal) tools and remote MCP servers are supported. A remote MCP server must first be shared to a space (global or a regular space the caller can access); it is matched by its display name, which must be unambiguous within the workspace.

skippedActions.description: Toolset entries that could not be applied (e.g. the referenced MCP server was not found, is not shared to an accessible space, or the name was ambiguous). The request still succeeds; inspect this list to confirm every intended tool was attached.

400.description: Bad Request. Invalid or missing parameters.

get.summary: Download a conversation-scoped file by path
get.description:
Download a file from a conversation's file system by its scoped path. Pass the
canonical `filePath` surfaced in a message action's `generatedFiles` (the legacy
`conversation/foo.pdf` form is also accepted). The file content is streamed
directly from the conversation mount.

parameters.name: rel
parameters.description:
Conversation-scoped file path: the canonical `filePath` returned in a message
action's `generatedFiles`, or the legacy `conversation/foo.pdf` form. Paths
scoped to another conversation or to a different scope are rejected. Path
traversal segments (`..`) are rejected.

400.description: Missing or invalid path parameters (e.g. missing or wrong scope prefix).

403.description: Resolved path is outside the conversation scope.

get.description:
[Documentation](https://docs.dust.tt/docs/client-side-mcp-server)
Server-Sent Events (SSE) endpoint that streams MCP tool requests for a workspace.
This endpoint is used by client-side MCP servers to listen for tool requests in real-time.
The connection will remain open and events will be sent as new tool requests are made.

Files generated by this action. Path-backed files have `fileId: null`
and can be downloaded through the conversation files endpoint using
`filePath`.

mentions.description: Empty array is accepted but won't trigger any agent.

ModelSelection.description:
Optional per-message model and reasoning-effort override applied to the
mentioned agent(s). When omitted, each agent runs its configured model.
A provider/model pair that is not authorized for the workspace is
rejected with a 400 (`model_disabled`), it does not fall back to the
agent's configured model. A malformed object, or an unknown reasoning
effort, also results in a 400.

reasoningEffort.description: Optional reasoning effort. Honored only if the resolved model supports it.
